hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; base=$(basename "$f" 2>/dev/null); if [[ "$base" =~ ^\.env(\..*)?$ ]] && [[ "$base" != *.example ]] && [[ "$base" != *.sample ]]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Blocked: .env files contain secrets and must not be read."}}'; fi; }

jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | { read -r cmd; if echo "$cmd" | grep -Eq '\.env(\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+)?([^A-Za-z0-9_.-]|$)' && ! echo "$cmd" | grep -Eiq '\.env\.(example|sample)\b'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Blocked: command references a .env file, which contains secrets and must not be read."}}'; fi; }
